verdict.rationale: smolagents is built around giving agents plain-language tasks: `agent.run("Calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to 10")` executes one, and the bundled `smolagent` and `webagent` CLI utilities run agents without writing boilerplate code. A hands-on report shows an agent working through a natural-language text-to-SQL task. That run hit a disallowed import and fell back to a workaround. Missing for 10: detailed docs on driving the CLI with natural-language prompts, a way to configure agents and tools without writing Python, and independent corroboration beyond one example run.
